overview: A "Reporting of Financial Information" clause in leases requires the tenant (lessee) to provide financial statements (e.g., balance sheets, profit & loss, tax returns) to the landlord or lender upon request. It ensures transparency, allowing the landlord to assess creditworthiness, monitor financial health, and verify compliance with obligations.
